product_one_liner.value: CloudTalk provides an AI-powered cloud business phone and voice-agent platform for sales and customer-support teams.
product_one_liner.notes: The company describes the service as an AI-powered business phone system and AI Voice Agent platform for sales and support teams.

pricing_page.notes: CloudTalk has a public pricing page with plans and related pricing links.

named_customers.notes: These customer names appear on CloudTalk's customer-stories page; they are customers, not partners or investors.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists CloudTalk's company size as 201–500 employees. CloudTalk's own story page also describes 200+ employees.

hq_location.notes: CloudTalk's company story identifies Bratislava, Slovakia, as its base and origin.

founded_year.notes: The company says it was founded in Bratislava in 2016.

eng_blog.notes: The public blog index is a sales/support strategy and marketing blog; it does not show at least two engineering-authored posts about product architecture, infrastructure, ML, data, incidents, or open source.

public_docs.notes: CloudTalk has a public Help Center with multiple article categories and a public developer portal/API documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The current job board lists openings, but none of the listed titles is an AI/ML, machine-learning, data-science, applied/research scientist, NLP, LLM, or computer-vision role. A Product Education Manager (AI-Enabled) title is not an AI/ML research or engineering role.

model_provider.value: CloudTalk publicly lists OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Deepgram, AssemblyAI, and ElevenLabs as AI-feature subprocessors/providers; it does not specify a particular model version.
model_provider.notes: The subprocessors page names these providers and describes their roles in Conversation Intelligence, voice-agent, and speech-to-text features. CloudTalk's AI Voice Agent guide does not specify one underlying model.

compliance_certs.notes: Listed certifications and compliance claims are limited to those named by CloudTalk on its security/trust materials; GDPR, HIPAA, and PCI DSS are stated as compliance claims.

last_funding.notes: The dated announcement reports CloudTalk's $28 million Series B closing on January 17, 2024; Tracxn lists that as its latest funding.

raised_18mo.notes: The last reported round was in January 2024, earlier than the 18-month window beginning 2025-05-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board's listed openings do not include SDR, BDR, sales/business-development representative, or account executive titles.

launched_6mo.notes: The readable blog index has dated posts through 2026-11-09, but the recent entries are guides, comparisons, and marketing content; it does not show a dated product launch or major feature announcement within the six-month window (2026-05-09 to 2026-11-09).

leadership_change_12mo.notes: I could verify the current company story and founder/CEO information, but did not find a sufficiently complete, checkable leadership roster or a dated join/departure announcement to establish whether a C-level or VP-level change occurred in the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: These named services appear on CloudTalk's integrations page, which visibly identifies its CRM, sales, and collaboration-system integrations.
